stonemtn.display: Stone Mountain Park, Stone Mountain, DeKalb County, Georgia, 30087, United States
stonemtn.signature_note: Client, 10-08: "people go up and down Stone Mountain... people climb the mountain, walk it every day, it's a trail there." He was right and the research confirms it: the Walk-Up Trail is ~1 mile to the summit with ~700 ft of gain, and the Cherokee Trail is a 5-mile loop around the base. Both are mapped in OSM and BOTH were outside the old 800 m extract, which is why the circuit finder reported no loop at all. Rebuilt at 1700 m: the Walk-Up Trail measures 1,994 m climbing 197 m, the Cherokee Trail 7,396 m climbing 51 m. The level uses the WALK-UP TRAIL because the identity of this location is the climb — a circuit search here returns a flat car-park ring at -2% grade, which is technically a lap and is not Stone Mountain.

apache.name: Apache Cafe (closed) — 64 Third Street NW
apache.display: The Midtown room on Third Street NW, west of Peachtree. Closed after 20 years; the building is not mapped and the venue has no OSM feature.
apache.note: Client called it the OLD Apache Kafe, which is the original Midtown room at 64 Third Street NW (30308) — not the later Marietta St location. TRAP: every geocoder returns a DIFFERENT 3rd Street NW in Bankhead (30318), because OSM spells the Midtown one "Third Street Northwest". Searching "3rd" silently gives you an address 2.5 km away in the wrong neighbourhood. Centred on the east (Peachtree) end of the way, since 64 is a low number. This is a STREET-level fix, not a surveyed building: the venue is gone and nothing in OSM marks it. Needs client photo reference for the facade.
